G001.target_statement: Use Uber to get from one place to another.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 受访者明确把“从一个地方到另一个地方”的交通称为使用 Uber 的主要目标；引文为完整判断句，主体与结果一致。

G002.target_statement: Decide whether to take a ride mainly by the trip duration and the price, and walk instead when a ride would take too long (for example about an hour and a half).
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原句明确以所需时间或价格决定是否叫车，并以“要一个半小时就走路”为例；例子写为目标内的示例，未另建阈值。
supported_parts: 以时间与价格为决策依据

G003.target_statement: Choose the cheapest ride option when booking, except when traveling with more people, where a larger four-seat car is chosen instead.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句直接说明通常选最便宜的一项，并以同行多人为例外（随后举例四人座 comfort 车型）；“usually”与例外均保留。
supported_parts: 同行多人时改选更大的车

G004.target_statement: Wait instead of booking immediately when the quoted price is too high.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原句明确“价格太高时可以选择等”，属可选做法；目标保留“can choose”的可选性，未写成必须。

G005.target_statement: On work trips where the employer covers the cost, accept a higher price (for example 20 dollars more) to avoid a longer wait (for example 20 extra minutes).
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句明确在工作出行且公司承担费用时更看重时间而非价格，并举出多付 20 美元少等 20 分钟的例子；条件与例子均保留。
supported_parts: 工作出行的价格/时间权重反转
为少等待接受额外费用

G006.target_statement: Avoid cancelling a booked ride, because cancellations damage the passenger rating.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句直接表达尽量避免取消及其原因（影响乘客评分）；“usually try not to”的强度保留，未写成绝不取消。

G007.target_statement: Be able to talk to a human customer-service agent when trying to resolve an issue.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原句明确“想和人说话”，并区分了只回答具体问题与真正解决纠纷两种情形；目标限定在解决纠纷时找人工。
supported_parts: 解决纠纷时需要人工客服

G008.target_statement: Prefer, most of the time, a single destination over multiple stops when taking an Uber.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句明确多数情况下更愿只去一个地点；保留“most of the time”与“would prefer”的偏好强度，并记录多段行程仍会使用。

G009.target_statement: When a multi-stop trip is used, keep the in-between stops as quick as possible.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句直接说明中途停靠耗时会让其不自在，并“尽量让停靠快”；属多段行程内的局部意图，与 G008 的一般偏好分开保留。
supported_parts: 多段行程中途停靠尽量快

G010.target_statement: Contact the driver through the app's call or messaging feature to coordinate the pickup when the pickup point is hard to find or the area is busy.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句明确表示使用过应用内通话/消息并“觉得很有帮助”，并列出难找、繁忙等具体情境；这是对既有做法与用途的正面表述，未提出变更要求，目标只记录该做法及其适用情境。
supported_parts: 通过应用内通话/消息联系司机
适用于上车点难找或繁忙时

G011.target_statement: Tell the driver directly about a pickup change instead of changing the pickup location in the app.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句明确改点时通常直接告知司机而不在应用内操作；采访者总结“直接联系司机是你的首选”后受访者以“Yeah”确认，方式与优先关系均直接支持。

G012.target_statement: Change the pickup location in the app with little effort after it has been set from the current location.
G012.label: inferred
G012.rationale: 原文只描述改点变难与绕行做法，没有明说“希望更容易”；但“以前相对容易”的肯定与改用告知司机构成正面推断依据，故判 inferred，假设已列入 inference。
supported_parts: 使用当前位置设点后应用内改点变难
assumptions: 易用性被视为可取状态
reasoning_steps: 识别对旧版易用性的肯定
推断希望应用内改点保持低阻力

G013.target_statement: View the ride fare after the trip to split the charge with friends or use it as a receipt for work reimbursement.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原句明确行程结束后回看车费，并给出分摊与报销两个用途；用途即预期结果，均为直接表述。

G014.target_statement: Not use Uber Eats, having stopped after the bad experience with it.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句直接说明经历糟糕并已停止使用，属避免型状态；将其作为维持性目标是最小解读，原文未表示会重新使用，也未明确未来计划。
supported_parts: 原因是估计差与客服差

G015.target_statement: Avoid taking the bus in areas the stakeholder is not familiar with.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句直接表达“不想在不熟悉的地方坐公交”，条件（不熟悉）与否定均保留。
supported_parts: 不熟悉区域避免坐公交

G016.target_statement: Choose Uber over the bus when the bus trip would be long or would require walking or transferring.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句在列举公交耗时、需步行或换乘后说“那样麻烦的话我会更愿意选 Uber”；转写“prefer And Uber”按上下文理解为“prefer an Uber”，语气 probably 保留。
supported_parts: 公交线路复杂时选 Uber
assumptions: 转写 prefer And Uber 指 prefer an Uber

G017.target_statement: Rent a car for travel when walkability and the amount of driving make it sensible, including week-long trips with substantial travel, for more freedom.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 两处原句都以同一核心动作（租车）表达偏好：工作或一般出行更愿租车，一周假期且出行较多时租车更自由；条件与理由分别保留，合并未改变语义。
supported_parts: 工作或一般出行偏好租车
取决于步行便利度与驾驶需求
